snippet.title: Ghost In The Shell,  out now  for  Game Boy Color! (Visual Novel)
snippet.description:
Ghost In The Shell GBC
Game Released by: avalentine1996
Page: *avalentine1996.itch.io*
Release date: November 16, 2025

Ghost In The Shell,  out now  for  Game Boy Color!

Experience the anime classic in this 8-bit Visual Novel by Multi Paint System.

Features;

-Hours of heart pumping dialogue!

-Multiple choices and exploration!

-Arcade  shooting and driving!

-5 endings to discover!

and more?

.....................................
